settings.editor:
This Privacy Policy explains how PornQuebec (“we”, “us”, “our”) collects, uses, shares and protects personal information when you visit pornquebec.ca (the “Site”) or contact us. PornQuebec is operated from Québec, Canada.

This policy applies to this Site only. The Site is intended for adults aged 18 and over. By using the Site you acknowledge this policy. Where the law requires your consent, we ask for it clearly, and you may withdraw it at any time.

Information you give us.

  • Your name, email address and the content of your message when you write to us through the contact page.
  • Your email address if you choose to receive updates from us.

Information collected automatically.

  • Technical data such as your IP address, approximate location (country or region), browser and device type, pages viewed, the page that referred you, and the date and time of your visit.
  • Choices you make on the Site, such as your language and cookie preferences.

We do not collect payment card details on this Site (see section 5). Because of the nature of our catalogue, we treat information about the pages you view as sensitive. Please do not include health or other sensitive details in messages to us unless they are necessary to your request.

We use personal information only for purposes we can explain:

  • to answer your questions and requests;
  • to send updates you asked to receive, with an unsubscribe link in every message;
  • to operate, secure and improve the Site, including troubleshooting and preventing fraud and abuse;
  • to understand which products and articles interest visitors, using aggregated statistics;
  • to record referrals to our partner merchants (see section 5);
  • to meet our legal obligations.

We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing.

Cookies are small files stored on your device. We use:

  • Essential cookies, to keep the Site working and secure and to remember your cookie choices;
  • Preference cookies, to remember settings such as your language;
  • Analytics cookies, to measure visits and improve the Site;
  • Referral cookies, which may be set when you click a link to a partner merchant so that the referral can be credited to us.

Where the law requires it, we ask for your consent before using non-essential cookies. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Doing so may affect features such as your saved preferences.

PornQuebec is a curated catalogue and journal. When you select a “Buy now” button or another product link, you leave our Site and go to a partner merchant’s website to complete your purchase. Our partner merchant is Lovense, operated by HYTTO PTE. LTD. (lovense.com).

The partner merchant, not PornQuebec, takes your order and payment, ships the products, handles returns and warranty, and collects the information needed to do so, such as your name, delivery address, payment details and order history. The merchant’s own Privacy Policy, published at lovense.com/privacy-policy, governs that information, and we encourage you to read it before you buy.

We never see or store your payment card details. We may earn a commission when you buy through our links. To credit referrals, the partner may place a cookie or identifier when you click through. We receive only referral reporting about purchases made through our links.

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in these limited cases:

  • Service providers that help us run the Site, such as website hosting, email, analytics and security providers. They may use your information only to perform services for us and must protect it.
  • Partner merchants, as described in section 5, limited to referral information.
  • Authorities and advisers, where the law requires it or to protect our rights, our users or others.
  • A successor, if our business is sold or reorganised, in which case this policy continues to apply to your information.

Our service providers may store or process information outside Québec, including outside Canada. Before information leaves Québec, we assess the privacy risks and use contracts and other safeguards to keep it protected to the standard Québec law requires.

We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described above, then we delete or anonymise it.

  • Contact messages are kept only as long as needed to handle your request and any follow-up.
  • Update subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe.
  • Server logs and analytics data are kept for a limited period and then deleted or aggregated.

We may keep information longer where the law requires it or where it is needed to handle a dispute.

We use reasonable safeguards to protect personal information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), access controls, limited access by our team and regular software updates. No online system is completely secure. If a security incident presents a risk of serious harm to you, we will notify you and the competent authorities as the law requires.

Under Québec and Canadian privacy law you may:

  • ask whether we hold personal information about you, and access it;
  • ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete information;
  • withdraw your consent to our use or sharing of your information;
  • ask us to delete your information, or to stop sharing it, where the law allows;
  • ask to receive your information in a structured, commonly used format;
  • unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time.

To use these rights, write to us through the contact page. We may need to confirm your identity first, and we will answer within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may contact the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec or the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

The Site is intended only for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has given us personal information, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.
We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top shows the latest version. If we make a significant change, we will tell you through a notice on the Site.

For any question about this policy or about your personal information, write to the person responsible for the protection of personal information at PornQuebec through our contact page.

This policy is available in French and English. If the two versions differ, the French version prevails.
Write to us and we will respond within 30 days.
